scope: Initial ownership-cycle register, not a complete alias/soundness proof. AST inventory and compiler expansion supply locations; each listed cycle still needs caller/indirect callback review.

regions.title: Input cache and retained file state
regions.logical_owner: filestate and buf linked storage plus file descriptors
regions.aliases_and_hazards: ch_* cache pointers, ifile handles and retained byte positions
regions.release_and_migration: ch_close/free/close; cross-file invalidation must retire every alias

regions.title: Expandable byte buffers
regions.aliases_and_hazards: raw data pointers escape to callers; self-copy/growth may invalidate source aliases
regions.release_and_migration: ecalloc/free; reserve-before-commit and borrowed-slice migration required

regions.title: Command injection queue
regions.aliases_and_hazards: SIGUSR1 ungetsc/ungetcc_back can mutate and allocate while interrupted code owns the queue
regions.release_and_migration: ecalloc/free; dispatch in main loop and define action accounting

regions.title: Rendered lines and source maps
regions.logical_owner: line buffers, attributes, converted bytes and source-position arrays
regions.aliases_and_hazards: display/search retain pointers across resize, conversion and replacement
regions.release_and_migration: ecalloc/free and replacement; retain maps under stable owner and generation

regions.title: Search filters and highlights
regions.logical_owner: filter_infos/pattern_info chains and converted line/match storage
regions.aliases_and_hazards: SIGINT enters set_filter_pattern and frees chains asynchronously; screen/search aliases need retirement
regions.release_and_migration: clear_pattern/free; staged compile/replace and main-loop-only mutation

regions.title: GNU regular expressions
regions.logical_owner: native regex_t buffer and native compile/match state
regions.aliases_and_hazards: GNU global syntax options and native error/range storage have distinct lifetimes
regions.release_and_migration: GNU compile/free ownership and matching allocator, no Rust freeing of borrowed native memory

regions.title: Positions marks and navigation
regions.logical_owner: position arrays, line indexes and mark records
regions.aliases_and_hazards: mark/file raw handles and position sentinel/width conversions survive file switches
regions.release_and_migration: invalidate marks/positions with file generation; explicit persistent restoration

regions.title: Configuration and language storage
regions.logical_owner: option values, lesskey tables, expansion and message/prompt storage
regions.aliases_and_hazards: borrowed getenv strings, allocated expansions and global option pointers cross parse/commit boundaries
regions.release_and_migration: owned parser outputs and configuration precedence; M2.3 parser slice precedes whole-state closure

regions.title: Terminal session and output capabilities
regions.logical_owner: terminal state, terminfo capability/scratch strings and output buffers
regions.aliases_and_hazards: native capability scratch lifetime and callback context; session restoration during stop/child handoff
regions.release_and_migration: termios/session restoration and explicitly scoped native callbacks; no C unwind

regions.title: OS process resources and handoff
regions.logical_owner: FDs, FILE pointers, child processes, command strings and input replacements
regions.aliases_and_hazards: startup/shutdown/exec failure and SIGTERM can overlap active resource cleanup

regions.title: Signals and wait notification
regions.logical_owner: signal dispositions/masks, atomic I/O flags, legacy sigs and timer state
regions.aliases_and_hazards: fabricated function-pointer sentinels, asynchronous mutable globals and ppoll/read/open windows
regions.release_and_migration: checked dispositions, reviewed notification and rollback; FIFO feasibility in M1.1

regions.title: Companion and bitfield dependency
regions.logical_owner: lessecho argument/output state and generated packed field access
regions.aliases_and_hazards: raw/native calls and macro-expanded generated pointer/bit storage
regions.release_and_migration: lessecho byte semantics; retire unnecessary bitfield code or narrowly audit boundary

regions.title: Test-only allocation injection boundary
regions.logical_owner: One main-entry configuration owns a dedicated inherited trace pipe; atomics own ordinal/hit state.
regions.aliases_and_hazards: Fixed stack event is borrowed only during nonblocking write; errno is thread-local. Existing signal-to-allocation paths remain hazardous until M1.
regions.release_and_migration: Close-on-exec prevents ordinary helper inheritance; process exit closes the dedicated descriptor. No raw memory is returned by the hook.

native_trust.name: libc/glibc
native_trust.limitations: System library internals uninstrumented; Rust layouts must be checked on each ABI.

native_trust.name: GNU regex
native_trust.limitations: Native syntax/allocation internals uninstrumented; owning wrapper and semantic/native probes remain M4.

native_trust.name: ncurses/terminfo
native_trust.limitations: Capability buffers and callback lifetimes need independent review; no audit of system library internals.

native_trust.name: Rust standard library/compiler
native_trust.limitations: Prebuilt normal/ASan std and compiler trusted; Miri builds its own pinned-source interpreter sysroot.

native_trust.name: C2Rust bitfields
native_trust.limitations: Vendored unsafe and derive-generated code included in source/expanded inventory; independent audit or removal remains pending.
